parts.t: Browse every townhome and townhouse for sale in Willoughby, Township of Langley below, at any price, and contact Jared today if you have questions.
Below are the townhomes for sale in Willoughby, Township of Langley, at any price. Willoughby is planned neighbourhood by neighbourhood, and each plan says where townhouses can go.
Willoughby isn't one subdivision. It's a set of planned neighbourhoods, each with its own plan. Since June 15, 2026, the Township's
community and neighbourhood plans page
lists these for Willoughby:
Willoughby Transit Corridor Plan.
Takes in the old Carvolth, Latimer, Jericho, Routley and South West Gordon Estate areas along 200 Street.
Gordon Neighbourhood Plan.
Combines the Central and North East Gordon Estate plans.
Yorkson, Smith and Williams.
These kept their own neighbourhood plans, updated in December 2025.
Knowing which plan a complex sits in helps. It tells you what could be built next door, and if your street is mostly finished or still filling in.
The Township's
Willoughby Community Plan update

page says the new plans aim for more density near a proposed bus rapid transit line on 200 Street, with five stations. Each station is envisioned as a neighbourhood hub with more intensive mixed-use development.

The Township also allows projects that applied before June 15, 2026 to proceed under the old plans until June 15, 2028. So a complex going up next to you this year may follow the old rules, not the new ones. If you're buying a presale townhome, ask the developer which plan the project was approved under.
Willowbrook Station on the
Surrey Langley SkyTrain
line will sit at the northeast corner of 196 Street and Fraser Highway, with a transit exchange. The Province expects service in
late 2029
. For townhome owners in west Willoughby, that's a new way to get to Surrey and Vancouver without the car.
When you tour Willoughby complexes, compare these:
Garage type.
Side-by-side double versus tandem. It matters if you have two cars or a truck.
Yard.
Fenced yard, patio or deck only.
Floors.
If stairs are a concern, look for a main-floor bedroom.
Amenities.
Some complexes have shared amenities like a play area or amenity room, and those costs show up in the strata fee.
Every complex here is a strata. Ask for the
Form B
, which lists the monthly fee, levies and an insurance summary. Read the
depreciation report
, required every five years for stratas with five or more lots in B.C.
For schools, start with the district. In the
Langley School District (SD35)
R.E. Mountain Secondary
is at 7633 202A Street and
Yorkson Creek Middle School
is at 20686 84 Avenue. The district groups schools in
school family groups
, and catchments follow the address, so confirm for any unit you like.
FVREB doesn't publish a Willoughby figure. Its Langley townhouse benchmark covers Willoughby along with the rest of Langley. Source: FVREB.

Which neighbourhood plans cover Willoughby townhomes?
Since June 2026: the Willoughby Transit Corridor Plan, the Gordon Neighbourhood Plan, and the Yorkson, Smith and Williams plans.
What is planned along 200 Street in Willoughby?
The proposed bus rapid transit line includes five stations within the Willoughby Transit Corridor Plan area, each envisioned as a new neighbourhood hub with more intensive mixed-use development.
Where are R.E. Mountain Secondary and Yorkson Creek Middle?
R.E. Mountain Secondary is at 7633 202A Street and Yorkson Creek Middle School is at 20686 84 Avenue. Check the catchment for each address with the district.
Is there a Willoughby-only townhouse price?
No. FVREB's Langley townhouse benchmark covers the City and Township together.
